perf.notes: v0.27 L3 packaging/perf UPGRADE: procedural LOD2 far body + lid use MeshBasicMaterial (unlit / card-like) with the same 256² wood albedo as v0.26. No roughness/metalness uniforms (they do not apply to MeshBasic). LOD0 stays full photoreal MeshStandard at 512² (albedo + ORM + normalMap at modest full normalScale). LOD1 stays MeshStandard albedo-only at 256² (v0.25 constants: wood/handle roughness 220/255 metalness 8/255; brass latch roughness 95/255 metalness 230/255). Unique canvases still 11. Fastener is not an LOD mesh and stays on shared LOD0 brass MeshStandard. Runtime prefers a packaged GLB when present and does not rewrite materials at ingest — author LOD2 as unlit/basic (or KHR_materials_unlit) with ≤256² albedo and no normalTexture + ORM per docs/performance/ktx2-quest3-packaging.md. v0.26 half-res albedo, v0.25 LOD1 albedo-only, v0.24 LOD1 no-normals, v0.23 LOD2 ORM drop, v0.22 framebuffer scale, v0.21 anisotropy clamp, v0.20 ambient-only fill, v0.19 directional off, v0.18 IBL off, v0.17 NoToneMapping, v0.16 MSAA off, v0.15 pixel-ratio clamp, v0.14 LOD1 normalScale, v0.13 LOD2 no-normals, v0.12 normals, v0.11 visibility-loss release, v0.10 tracking-loss / null-pose release, v0.9 hand hover-before-pinch, and v0.8 allocation scrub kept (no per-frame new THREE.* when P overlay is off). Runtime probes /packaged/crate-toolbox.glb and falls back to procedural canvases. No GLB in this revision. LOD draws unchanged (14/8/2 + fastener 1). Quest 3 frame time / FFR still unmeasured.
